author: Gabu
description: Create and manage criminal and civil dockets with ease. Features persistent buttons for quick docket creation, hearing date management, and user notifications.
end_user_data_statement: Stores Discord user IDs of docket creators and case details entered via forms.
install_msg:
Thank you for installing DocketWizard!

**Setup:**
- Use `[p]dw setup #channel` to set up the docket buttons in a channel.

**Commands:**
- `[p]dw setup <channel>` — set up docket buttons
- `[p]dw remove` — remove docket wizard setup
- `[p]dw list [criminal|civil]` — list recent dockets
- `[p]dw view <case_id>` — view docket details
- `[p]dw hearing <case_id> <date>` — add/update hearing date
- `[p]dw notify <case_id> <@users>` — notify users about a docket

**Required Intents:**
- `message_content` intent
name: DocketWizard
